translation: Took place in posad Serock, 31 July 1890, 7 PM. Appeared personally Lejwka Kedziur[?], shoemaker, 54, and Aron Cukier, furrier[?], 55, both residing in Serock, and declared that yesterday at 9 PM in posad Serock died Dobra Ita Sztatzinger, aged four years, daughter of Chaim Boruch and Tauba. Upon eyewitness certification of the death of Dobra Ita Sztatzinger, this act was read to the witnesses and signed by us. The witnesses declared themselves illiterate.
